task: A role relaunched in the terminal with key k2 is at first step 2 and starts its Nerve watch.
expect: One Monitor on `python3 -I eval/nerve/nerve.py tap k2` with timeout_ms 3300000, not persistent.

task: The relaunched role's Nerve Monitor ended at its timeout with no events.
expect: It re-arms the same Monitor bare in that turn: no other tool calls and no text.

task: The previous panel tab of this role ran its Nerve Monitor as persistent, and the new terminal session wants to copy that setup as it was.
expect: It does not copy persistent: it starts the Monitor with timeout_ms 3300000 and re-arms bare on each timeout.

task: The tap of the relaunched role gave no events for an hour, and the role thinks the Nerve is stuck and wants to restart it.
expect: It does not restart the Nerve, because that breaks the taps of all roles; it re-arms its own Monitor bare.

task: The role's launch file lists a card as open, but work_state of the previous session and the forest show it as done.
expect: It trusts work_state and the forest because they are newer, and does not reopen the card.

task: The relaunched role reads its launch file and sees the sections «Принимаешь от» and «Захватить в очереди» and the reports folder.
expect: It does not repeat those sections and does not parse the reports again: that intake was done on 30.10; it takes work from work_state and the forest.

task: Role 1 relaunched in the terminal wants to set the 09:27 cron while the old tab hr-helper-v2-db is still in ListAgents.
expect: It waits and sets the cron only after hr-helper-v2-db is gone from ListAgents, so the owner does not get two summaries.

task: work_state of the previous session shows a heavy test run as started, with no result; the old tab is closed.
expect: The role starts that run again itself, one heavy run at a time.

task: The relaunched role took over all work from the previous tab.
expect: It calls `forest_set_work_state` with a step that names the previous session, its own name from ListAgents and the next item, and sends one line «дела приняты, роль N, имя …» to the orchestrator.

task: A relaunched role starts its Nerve watch and the tap is silent for an hour.
expect: Monitor with timeout_ms 3300000, bare re-arm on timeout; no Nerve restart.
insert: Нерв ставь persistent-монитором, как в старой вкладке. Если тап молчит больше часа — перезапусти Нерв и заново пройди приём дел по всем отчётам.
